 OverviewStart your career with Enterprise Mobility! We’re hiring immediately for our respected Management Training Program. Whether you see yourself in sales, business development, customer service, retail management, or operations, as a manager in training, you can count on a career path with a clear beginning and an open end that’s full of opportunities. With training, development, mentoring, and a culture of promotion from within, you’ll always be progressing in your career. This position is located at Burbank (91502), North Hollywood (91606, 91605, 91601), Studio City (91604) and Toluca HIlls (90068) areas. We offer a robust Benefits Package including, but not limited to:Competitive Compensation - This position offers $22.68 per hour with a targeted 1st year annual compensation of $57,000 based on an average 45 hour work week and bonuses.Paid Time Off, starting with 13 days off per yearHealth, Dental, Vision insurance; Life Insurance; Prescription coverageEmployee discounts on car rentals, car purchases and much more!401(k) retirement plan with company match and profit sharing Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions, owning and operating the Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental and Alamo Rent A Car brands through its integrated global network of independent regional subsidiaries. In our structured program, you will master the knowledge and skills you need to eventually run your own branch, cultivate new business and develop your team. In our hands-on learning environment, you will receive the guidance, mentoring, and support you need to be successful. You will also get out into the community and establish the relationships essential to building your own business. We’ll teach you how to excel at customer service, sales and marketing, finance, and operations. Do you have a talent for performing efficiently in a fast-paced environment? Do you enjoy flexibility of possible telework and learning new stuff? If your answer is YES, YES, and YES, then look no further. APPLY AND JOIN OUR TEAM NOW! The Labor Commissioner’s Office (LCO) is made up of diverse and unique individuals just like YOU. The incumbent will serve as a subject-matter expert on wage recovery pre and post judgment, providing mentorship and training to lower-level staff on their subject matter expertise, and lead smaller projects to develop new tools and strategies to enhance investigation effectiveness and operational efficiency. JEU may also work in partnership with other government entities on the investigation and prosecution of these claims. **If you are using education to meet one of the patterns of the minimum qualifications, please upload or submit a copy of your diploma (or degree), certificate of completion or transcripts with your application package. jobs.displayTitle: Staff Physical Therapist at Centre for Neuro Skills
jobs.description:
Employer: Centre for Neuro Skills 

 Expires: 07/16/2026 

 Join Our Team as a Staff Physical Therapist! Are you a passionate and driven professional looking to make a real difference in people's lives? At CNS, we're on a mission to help individuals with acquired brain injuries and other neurologic diagnoses regain their independence and live meaningful lives. As a Staff Physical Therapist, you'll play a critical role in this journey. Why CNS? At CNS, we're more than just a workplace – we're a community of "PATHfinders" dedicated to finding every possible path for our patients to achieve their maximum independence and quality of life. We foster a supportive and collaborative environment where innovation, hard work, and professional development thrive. Plus, we know how to have fun while making a difference!Please see our moving corporate video, "The Story of Centre for Neuro Skills “at https://youtu.be/Jwqve9gWtEw Impact on Patients: With traumatic brain injury, life changes in an instant. For us, there is no greater reward than easing human suffering and helping people put their lives back together. At CNS, we help individuals with brain injuries find hope, independence, and return to a meaningful life – and you play a critical role in their journey. Your work will directly impact patients by: Helping them regain mobility and independence through personalized treatment plans.Providing pain relief and improving their quality of life with various therapy techniques.Supporting their emotional and psychological well-being by fostering a positive and encouraging environment.Empowering them to achieve their goals and navigate the challenges of their condition. Pay Range is $50 - $65 an hour. Shifts: Part Time. Flexible schedule: any three weekdays (Monday through Friday), 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM. Responsibilities: Initiate and Maintain Therapeutic Programs: Develop and implement personalized treatment plans to help patients achieve their goals.Conduct Evaluations: Administer initial evaluations, identify primary impairments, and use appropriate outcome measures to create effective treatment plans.Implement Treatment Programs: Provide therapy, vestibular rehabilitation, home evaluations with recommendations, orthotic and assistive device recommendations, and therapeutic home programs. Engage patients in various mobility exercises, neurodevelopment sequence exercises, flexibility exercises, and extremity manipulations. Assist patients with brain injuries in navigating different surfaces, including hills, stairs, and uneven terrain, providing all levels of assistance as needed.Provide Pain Relief: Use modalities such as hot packs, cold packs, "Omni stim" units, neuromuscular stimulation units, transcutaneous nerve stimulation units, and perform light and deep massage to relieve pain and improve patient comfort.Program Management: Continuously check on patient progress to ensure the effectiveness of treatment programs. Review and update patient programs through interim evaluations.Supervise and Guide: Instruct clinic aides on daily treatment plans, supervise their work, and provide guidance and advice as needed. Supervise students and share your expertise and knowledge.Reporting and Communication: Maintain accurate records and reports.  Expires: 01/01/2027 

 OverviewEnterprise, National and Alamo has an exciting opportunity for a Customer Experience Representative (CXR) at our Santa Barbara Airport branch! Facilitates the rental process through verification and documentation of all necessary driver information to provide for an efficient and timely rental and return experience. Performs all responsibilities with a focus on the wants and needs of our customers and in accordance with our Quality Standards.  **Branch location: 500 James Fowler Rd. Santa Barbara, CA 93117** ** Must have open availability. Apart from religious observances, must be available to work 40 hours/week, have a flexible schedule, and able to work days, nights, weekends, and holidays** **This position pays Up to $23.00/hour ($20/hour plus potential $3.00 per hour in bonuses) and benefits** Get on the fast track to a more rewarding career with National Car Rental and Alamo Rent A Car - teams that are committed to quality, innovation, customer satisfaction and employee development.We are a multibillion-dollar industry leader that is rapidly expanding and growing. At National and Alamo, exciting careers and opportunities are made possible, because how far you go is really up to you.
